entries.message: Feature - Keep Up Next aligned with Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin rails
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep Plembfin's Up Next in step with Plex and Emby Continue Watching and Jellyfin Next Up, refreshing those rails from watched episodes rather than inventing resume progress
Promote a ready episode to the front of Jellyfin's Next Up without resetting genuine progress or play counts
Stop a rail position Plembfin created being mistaken for real resume progress, and keep those sessions out of Now Playing
Remember dismissed Trakt not-found results across retries, so an unavailable show stops returning as a sync issue
Mark the dismissed Up Next button with a hidden-item icon and a count, and keep it hidden until something has been dismissed
Explain in Settings how the Up Next sync toggle keeps the queue aligned with Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, and how turning it off leaves those app lists unchanged
